Comparing the two would report a near-zero chance for every option no matter how good the options are, so goal-fit probabilities were withheld for this run rather than shown. Setting a current value for "Six-month decision spend" would not change that — it is calculated from its inputs, so it has no measured starting point of its own to anchor to.
